text:
Priya: Heads-up — ACME SI is asking for a minimized evidence bundle for the marketplace listing: SOC2 report excerpts, pen-test executive summary, and architecture diagram. They want a short manifest + presigned links by EOD Friday. Who can own the extraction + redaction pipeline?
Evan: I can own the extractor + presign flow. Need the canonical questionnaire -> evidence mapping first.
Marco: I put a starter mapping in the sheet: https://docs.internal/redwood/marketplace-evidence-mapping (see tab 'ACME-minimal') — columns: questionnaire_field, source_hint, priority.
Tessa: SecurityOps will sign off on redaction rules. Quick reminders: no raw logs, strip cloud account IDs, redact user emails and IPs, remove any screenshots with customer data.
Priya: Great — Evan, can you prototype a pipeline that reads the mapping + runs a lightweight parser over SOC2 PDF and pen-report PDF and outputs a CSV manifest and S3 objects? We should support a manual verify step.
Evan: Plan sketch: 1) PDF text extraction (pdfminer) + simple regex control mapping; 2) pen-test: extract 'summary' and list of findings (title + severity) only; 3) pull architecture diagram from appendix (if image) and run image checksum; 4) redaction pass (PII regex) before upload; 5) produce manifest.csv with rows: field, evidence_type, object_key, presign_ttl_days, redaction_notes.
Evan: Example manifest row: "SOC2 Control CC6.1","soc2_excerpt","s3://marketplace/partners/acme/soc2/cc6_1.txt","7","emails redacted"
Priya: TTL preference = 7 days for presigned links. Also need an attestation file from our SOC owner stating 'extracted for marketplace review only'.
Marco: Added a column in the sheet for 'attestation_required' and 'attestation_owner'.
Tessa: Redaction rules (high level): remove emails, phone numbers, ipv4/ipv6, AWS/GCP account IDs (regex), user IDs that match internal patterns. Keep control text intact where possible. We'll review a sample before sign-off.
MarketplaceBot: Auto-checklist created: [extractor PR], [redaction run], [manual review], [presign upload], [security attestation]. Trigger @MarketplaceBot when ready to generate presigns.
Evan: Quick redaction prototype (to test on dev bucket):
```python
import re
def redact(text):
    text = re.sub(r"[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}", "[REDACTED_EMAIL]", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\b(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)(?:\.(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)){3}\b", "[REDACTED_IP]", text)
    text = re.sub(r"(aws|gcp|azure)[-_:]?\w{8,}", "[REDACTED_ACCOUNT]", text, flags=re.I)
    return text
```
Evan: I'll drop a PR for the lambda extractor + one-off job that runs against the partner dev bucket.
Priya: Owners: Evan = extractor + presign, Tessa/SecurityOps = redaction rules & final sign-off, Marco = mapping upkeep & attestation owner. I'll coordinate the ACME contact and confirm scope.
Marco: Reminder — partner explicitly said 'no full reports in S3' — only minimal excerpts + manifest. We must ensure we don't upload full PDF.
Tessa: If any extracted snippet is longer than 2 pages, flag for manual review.
Evan: Will add automatic 'excerpt_length' check and a reviewer label. Also will produce a small 'evidence_manifest.csv' with header: field, evidence_type, object_key, preview_text_snippet (redacted), presign_ttl_days, reviewer.
Priya: Timeline: prototype by Wednesday EOD, sample bundle to SecurityOps Thursday morning, final upload to staging + presigns Friday noon.
SecurityOps: Ack — we'll block a 30-min review slot Thursday 11:00.
MarketplaceBot: Reminder scheduled: /remind @Priya and @Evan to upload sample bundle Thursday 09:00.
Evan: One question — do we use existing presign service or a short-lived storage bucket for partner artifacts?
Priya: Use existing presign service, it already records uploader and TTL. Make sure presigned links are scoped to partner prefix.
Marco: I'll update the sheet with the 'scoped_prefix' field and example keys.
Tessa: Also ensure audit log entry includes which questionnaire field each artifact maps to. Security will verify auditability during review.
Priya: Thanks team. Evan — ping here when PR is up. I'll loop in partner contacts after we pass SecurityOps review.
Evan: Will do. Quick note — for ambiguous mappings, I'll add a 'candidate' flag in the manifest for manual acceptance.
Marco: +1. Also please add a short README in the PR describing how to run locally and a toy sample input.
Priya: Perfect. Closing the thread for now — will re-open with the sample bundle. :white_check_mark:
